# cycle_image_source (Resource)

Manages a Cycle image source — the set of instructions telling Cycle where to find and how to build container images. Exactly one origin (e.g. `docker_hub`, `docker_registry`, `oci_registry`, `docker_file`, or `cycle_source`) must be set under `origin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull an image from Docker Hub.
resource "cycle_image_source" "docker_hub" {
  name        = "nginx"
  type        = "direct"
  description = "Official nginx image from Docker Hub."

  origin = {
    docker_hub = {
      target = "nginx:1.27"
    }
  }
}

# Pull from a private registry (credentials are marked sensitive).
resource "cycle_image_source" "private_registry" {
  name = "internal-api"
  type = "direct"

  origin = {
    docker_registry = {
      target   = "myorg/internal-api:latest"
      url      = "registry.example.com"
      username = var.registry_username
      password = var.registry_password
    }
  }
}

# Build from a Dockerfile in a git repository.
resource "cycle_image_source" "from_repo" {
  name = "my-app"
  type = "direct"

  origin = {
    docker_file = {
      repo_url   = "https://github.com/myorg/my-app.git"
      branch     = "master"
      build_file = "Dockerfile"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the image source.
- `origin` (Attributes) Where the image comes from. Exactly one of the nested origins must be set, mirroring the Cycle API's image origin union. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin))
- `type` (String) The type of images in this source. One of `direct`, `stack-build`, or `bucket`. Changing this forces a new image source to be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the image source (maps to the API's `about.description`).
- `identifier` (String) A human-readable slug identifier for this image source. Generated from the name by the platform when not provided.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the image source.
- `state` (String) The current state of the image source (e.g. `live`).

<a id="nestedatt--origin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin`

Optional:

- `cycle_source` (Attributes) Derive images from another existing Cycle image source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin--cycle_source))
- `docker_file` (Attributes) Build the image from a Dockerfile located in a git repository or a tar.gz archive. One of `repo_url` or `targz_url` should be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin--docker_file))
- `docker_hub` (Attributes) Pull the image from Docker Hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin--docker_hub))
- `docker_registry` (Attributes) Pull the image from a private Docker registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin--docker_registry))
- `oci_registry` (Attributes) Pull the image from an OCI-compatible registry (also used for provider-native registries such as AWS ECR). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin--oci_registry))

<a id="nestedatt--origin--cycle_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin.cycle_source`

Required:

- `source_id` (String) The ID of the image source images originate from.


<a id="nestedatt--origin--docker_file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin.docker_file`

Optional:

- `branch` (String) The git branch to build from. Defaults to `master` on the platform.
- `build_file` (String) The path to the Dockerfile used for building the image.
- `context_dir` (String) The path of the directory used as the build context.
- `repo_url` (String) The URL of the git repository containing the Dockerfile.
- `targz_url` (String) A URL serving a .tar.gz archive of the repository, used instead of a git URL.


<a id="nestedatt--origin--docker_hub"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin.docker_hub`

Required:

- `target` (String) The Docker Hub target string, e.g. `mysql:5.7`.

Optional:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) A token for authenticating with Docker Hub.
- `username` (String) A username for authenticating with Docker Hub.


<a id="nestedatt--origin--docker_registry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin.docker_registry`

Required:

- `target` (String) The image name on the registry, e.g. `myorg/myimage:latest`.
- `url` (String) The URL of the remote registry.

Optional:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) A password for authenticating with the registry.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A token for authenticating with the registry.
- `username` (String) A username for authenticating with the registry.


<a id="nestedatt--origin--oci_registry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin.oci_registry`

Required:

- `target` (String) The image name on the registry.
- `url` (String) The URL of the remote registry.

Optional:

- `token` (String, Sensitive) A token for user/token authentication with the registry.
- `username` (String) A username for user/token authentication with the registry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Image sources are imported by image source ID.
terraform import cycle_image_source.docker_hub 651586fca6078e98982dbd90
```
